Notes on this data: Source is the EMS reservations export for Earl Hall and St. Paul's Chapel, three fiscal years (FY2023–24 through FY2025–26): 2,832 distinct bookings, deduplicated from 8,068 billing/service line-item rows in the raw export. This export does not include a distinct attendance or guest-count field. Setup Count — the room capacity/configuration number entered on each booking, since that's what determines how the room gets set up — is the only quantity metric present, so it's used throughout as the proxy for event size, including the "Events with 50+ attendees" quick filter and "Min. guest count" field. If a true attendance figure exists elsewhere (e.g. a post-event headcount), it isn't in this export and would need to come from a different source.

Category is a first-pass classification based on organization name, group type, and event type, checked in this order: Weddings = org name contains "wedding" or event type is Wedding; Memorials = event type is Memorial Service; SPS = org name contains "SPS"; Community Impact = org name contains "Community Impact"; Religious Life = Office of Religious Life or org name matches religious-group keywords; Registrar Classrooms = Columbia University Registrar bookings; University Life = Division of University Life, UNL EVP, and Center for Student Success and Intervention bookings; Student Group = remaining Recognized Student Group bookings; everything else is Other. Flag any miscategorized organizations and the rules can be adjusted.

Status is normalized from about 20 raw EMS status codes into: Confirmed, Cancelled, Denied, No Show, Tentative, Pending, Wait List, Charge Only.

Fields not available as filters — because they're free text or too high-cardinality for a clean dropdown (1st Contact, Added By, Changed By, Cancelled By, Adviser, Notes, Special Instructions, exact Resource names, Reservation IDs, Booking IDs) — are reachable two ways: the search box above matches against all of them, and clicking any row in the table below opens the full record, including every contact field, every date, notes, special instructions, and the complete billing line-item breakdown for that booking.

Room names were consolidated from several inconsistent spellings in the source export (e.g. "Earl Hall - Auditorum", "Aud", "Auditorium" all map to "Earl Hall Auditorium").
